# T3rnel Business Intelligence

> Offline-first bookkeeping for Zimbabwean SMEs — EcoCash-aware capture,
> ZIMRA fiscal-ready invoices, driver profitability, English/Shona/Ndebele.
> Local-first install; no cloud account, no public API.

- [Overview](https://bi.t3ratech.co.zw/): what it does and who it's for
- [Privacy](https://bi.t3ratech.co.zw/privacy.html): what stays on the device
- [AGENTS.md](https://bi.t3ratech.co.zw/AGENTS.md): rules for agent visitors
